title: Payoneer Lands Conditional Approval to Open Stablecoin Bank
message_html: Payoneer Lands Conditional Approval to Open Stablecoin Bank ...
snippet: Payoneer says it has moved one step closer to establishing its stablecoin-centric bank. The cross-border payments FinTech announced Monday (Nov. 23) that it had received preliminary conditional approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to establish PAYO Digital Bank. title: Stablecoin FX platform Codex raises $30m
snippet: Codex has raised $30 million in Series A funding for its platform that enables businesses to convert, receive, and send fiat currencies and stablecoins at institutional FX rates.
